body:
Lululemon Athletica (LULU) represents consumer discretionary stocks on the earnings calendar, with the athletic apparel retailer's fiscal second-quarter results due out after Thursday's close.

Wall Street is calling for LULU to report earnings of $1.80 per share (-41.9% YoY) on revenue of $2.5 billion, unchanged from the year-ago period.
